connector.name: Agent Memory MCP by xultrax-web
connector.registryDescription: Markdown memory for AI agents. Files you can read, edit, grep, and commit. Not a database.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-memory-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xultrax-web account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: AGENT_MEMORY_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to a custom memory storage directory. Overrides the default per-project location.

env.name: AGENT_MEMORY_SCOPE
env.description: Set to 'global' to store memories in ~/.agent-memory/ instead of the per-project default ./.agent-memory/.

env.name: AGENT_MEMORY_LOG
env.description: Log level: debug | info | warn | error. Defaults to info. Logs go to stderr (won't pollute MCP stdio).
